messages:
deploybot: PROMOTE_HOLD: change-window 'v1.44.1' auto-promotion paused. Pipeline 4188 failing on staging-quant-tests (flaky on nv-gpu-pool). Artifact restore returned inconsistent model shard checksums across mirrors.
Nora: which test is flaking? only the quantization smoke?
ci-bot: failing tests: ModelQuant.test_fp16_consistency (x3 failures), ImageSmoke.test_startup. See /ci/4188 logs.
Teo: logs show model shard 0007 restored with different sha on mirror-b vs mirror-a. Likely mirror replication skew or partial write.
infra-bot: INFRA-447 created for mirror replication lag in ap-southeast-1. Provider reports eventual consistency issues after maintenance.
Nora: change window ends in 28m. Options: (A) rebuild artifacts with new upload and re-run CI (~22m) or (B) pin last-known-good v1.44.0 and promote to avoid SLA impact.
ReleaseManager: prefer rebuild since candidate release; approve one quick rebuild+upload. If CI doesn't green in 15m, fallback to pin and manual promote.
Teo: kicking rebuild/upload now with additional md5 verification per shard. Command: `./ci/publish-model --shard-checksum --upload`
deploybot: note: auto-promo remains BLOCKED until artifact checksums match across mirrors for 1 full verify cycle. Manual promote allowed with ReleaseManager approval.
ci-bot: rebuild done, pipeline 4189 started. Staging-quant-tests running. ETA ~9m.
Nora: If this fails again, we should also consider adding a short delay before mirror reads to allow replication to converge.
ci-bot: pipeline 4189: staging-quant-tests passed. Model shard checksums verified across mirrors.
ReleaseManager: proceed with promote but run a 2% canary for 10m and monitor quant-test metrics. Keep auto-promo blocked until INFRA-447 resolved and mirror error rate <0.8% for 1h.
deploybot: canary launched by ReleaseManager token. Canary 2% for 10m.
Nora: canary smoke passed 10m. Rolling out to 50% now, will finish in 8m.
Teo: filed short follow-up: TICKET-INVEST-801 to add per-shard replication verification and small read-delay when mirror reports recent writes.
ReleaseManager: promote completed to prod. Documenting release notes: "Promoted v1.44.1 after rebuild due to transient mirror replication skew affecting model shards. Follow-up: replication verification and read-convergence delay."
deploybot: manual_promote recorded: `by=ReleaseManager; tag=v1.44.1; reason=mirror_replication_skew`. Auto-promo: BLOCKED.
Nora: closing hold for this window. Thanks team.
